description: Reviewed official issuer annual-report fundamentals for German listings absent from the ESEF registry.

rawProviderFields.de_reviewed_definitions: IFRS consolidated statements, EUR millions as published in SAP's integrated-report data workbook (sheets Income Statement, Financial Position, Cash Flows, Five-Year Summary). net_income = profit after tax incl. non-controlling interests (7,160.7 attributable to owners). ebitda = operating profit 9,617.5 + depreciation and amortization 1,311.5 (BIAP-derived, IFRS lines). total_debt = current 2,049.5 + non-current 6,020.5 financial liabilities (balance-sheet face, includes lease liabilities). free_cash_flow = company-reported 8,239.2. interest_expense not taken: face 'Finance costs' mixes non-interest items.

Siemens AG Q4/FY2025 earnings release (unaudited preliminary IFRS statements; audited annual report follows). Fiscal year ended 2025-09-30, EUR millions. net_income = net income incl. non-controlling interests (9,620 attributable to shareholders). operating_income = EBIT of continuing operations 9,992 and ebitda = 13,380 from the release's EBITDA reconciliation. total_debt = short-term debt and current maturities 11,174 + long-term debt 44,841 (includes Siemens Financial Services funding). free_cash_flow = reported continuing+discontinued 10,812; operating_cash_flow continuing+discontinued 13,257.

BMW Group Report 2025, Group column (automotive + financial services), EUR millions; page text obtained via fetch tool because the issuer CDN blocks the VPS; balance-sheet subtotals and revenue/net profit/total assets/equity/cash/operating cash flow reconcile exactly to the previously verified snapshot. operating_income = profit before financial result 10,186. ebitda = 10,186 + depreciation and amortisation of tangible, intangible and investment assets 8,692 (BIAP-derived; leased-product depreciation not separately stated). total_debt = financial liabilities non-current 68,159 + current 42,310 (includes financial-services funding). free_cash_flow deliberately not set: group investment line includes leased products.

Deutsche Telekom Annual Report 2025 consolidated statements, EUR millions. net_income = profit after taxes incl. non-controlling interests 14,926 (9,609 attributable to owners of the parent). ebitda = reported 48,831; operating_income = EBIT 24,822. retained_earnings = retained earnings incl. carryforwards (11,246) deficit + net profit 9,609 = (1,637). total_debt = financial liabilities 11,328 + 99,011 + lease liabilities 5,744 + 30,640. free_cash_flow = operating cash flow 40,627 less cash outflows for intangible assets 6,942 and PP&E 12,314 (BIAP-derived). interest_expense = face line 6,522 (gross).

Rheinmetall Annual Report 2025 consolidated statements (pp.199-201), EUR millions. revenue=Sales 9,935 (2024: 7,715). operating_income=EBIT 1,684. ebitda=EBIT 1,684 + income-statement amortization/depreciation/impairment 406 (BIAP-derived, continuing operations). net_income=earnings after taxes incl. non-controlling interests 835 (696 attributable to shareholders; includes discontinued operations -341). total_debt=non-current financial debts 1,155 + current financial debts 126. operating_cash_flow=2,287 (group incl. discontinued operations); free_cash_flow=2,287 less capex 872. total_liabilities=total assets 16,772 less equity 5,614; assets held for sale 1,270 and associated liabilities 708 are included. eps=basic EPS 15.38.

Infineon Annual Report 2025 consolidated statements (pp.93-96), EUR millions, fiscal year ended 2025-09-30. revenue=14,662 (FY2024 14,955). operating_income=operating profit 1,515. ebitda=operating profit 1,515 + depreciation and amortization 1,917 from the cash-flow statement (BIAP-derived; impairments of 272 not added back). net_income=profit for the period 1,015 (incl. discontinued +10). total_debt=short-term financial debt incl. current portion 1,047 + long-term financial debt 5,782 + current lease liabilities 82 + non-current lease liabilities 305. operating_cash_flow=3,217 (group); free_cash_flow=3,217 less payments for property, plant and equipment 1,800 and other intangible assets 294. interest_expense not reported separately (financial expenses 231 include non-interest items) so omitted. eps=basic EPS attributable to shareholders 0.77.

Vossloh Annual Report 2025 consolidated statements (pp.156-158), EUR millions. revenue=sales revenues 1,343.2 (2024: 1,209.6). operating_income=EBIT 111.9. ebitda=EBIT 111.9 + depreciation/amortization/impairment 69.1 from the cash-flow statement (BIAP-derived). net_income=net income incl. hybrid and non-controlling interests 79.9 (62.7 attributable to shareholders). total_debt=noncurrent financial liabilities 532.6 + current financial liabilities 168.9. operating_cash_flow=167.2; free_cash_flow=issuer-defined 98.8 (after 73.9 capex and incl. 5.5 equity-method distributions). total_liabilities=noncurrent 626.4 + current 684.7. interest_expense=interest and similar expense 29.3. eps=basic/diluted 3.24.

SGL Carbon Annual Report 2025 consolidated statements (pp.160-163) and economic report (pp.123-127), EUR millions. revenue=sales revenue 850.2 (2024: 1,026.4). operating_income=Group EBIT -11.2. ebitda=EBIT -11.2 + depreciation/amortization 54.4 from the cash-flow statement (BIAP-derived; issuer-adjusted EBITDA 135.0 excludes non-recurring items and is not used). net_income=net result for the year incl. non-controlling interests -78.3 (-79.2 attributable). total_debt=interest-bearing loans 227.0 + current portion 5.2 (convertible bonds at carrying amount; lease liabilities not included). operating_cash_flow=79.2; free_cash_flow=79.2 less capex 53.6. total_liabilities=total assets 1,167.4 less total equity 467.0 (includes 5.0 liabilities held for sale). interest_expense=34.5. eps=basic -0.65.

secunet Security Networks AG Geschaeftsbericht 2025, Konzernabschluss (pp.144-147), EUR. revenue=Umsatzerloese 458,834,817 (2024: 406,384,083). operating_income=EBIT 51,645,920. ebitda=EBIT + Abschreibungen auf Sachanlagen und immaterielle Vermoegenswerte 23,236,792 = 74,882,712 (matches issuer-reported EBITDA 74.9m). net_income=Konzernperiodenergebnis 33,336,255. total_debt=Leasingverbindlichkeiten kurzfristig 6,365,206 + langfristig 12,350,058 + kurzfristige Darlehen 1,473,843 (no long-term loans on the balance sheet). operating_cash_flow=62,495,462; free_cash_flow=62,495,462 less Investitionen in immaterielle Vermoegenswerte und Sachanlagen 8,236,739. total_liabilities=Aktiva gesamt less Eigenkapital gesamt. interest_expense=Zinsaufwendungen 883,524. eps=5.15 (unverwaessert/verwaessert). retained_earnings=Gewinnruecklagen.

CENIT AG Geschaeftsbericht 2025, Konzernabschluss (pp.56-61), EUR (statements in TEUR). revenue=Umsatzerloese 209,510 TEUR (2024: 207,333). operating_income=EBIT 307. ebitda=EBIT 307 + Abschreibungen 11,975 = 12,282 (matches issuer-reported EBITDA 12.3m). net_income=Konzernjahresergebnis -2,452 incl. minorities (-1,210 attributable). total_debt=Verbindlichkeiten gegenueber Banken 33,356 + 14 + Leasingverbindlichkeiten 4,269 + 3,936. operating_cash_flow=14,127; free_cash_flow=14,127 less Auszahlungen fuer Sachanlagen/immaterielle Vermoegenswerte 1,638. total_liabilities=langfristige 43,580 + kurzfristige Schulden 55,957. interest_expense=Zinsen und aehnliche Aufwendungen 3,970. eps=-0.14.

SMT Scharf AG Geschaeftsbericht 2025, Konzern-Bilanz / Gesamtergebnisrechnung / Kapitalflussrechnung (pp.52-56), EUR. revenue=Umsatzerloese 102,934,127 from continuing operations (2024: 92,668,971; restated for discontinued operations, so differs from the 103.9m in the press release). operating_income=EBIT 3,800,467. ebitda=EBIT + Abschreibungen 3,434,627 = 7,235,094 (BIAP-derived). net_income=Konzernjahresergebnis incl. minorities and discontinued operations -1,023,005. total_debt=Leasingverbindlichkeiten 1,457,646 + 871,905 + langfristige Finanzverbindlichkeiten 1,250,967 + kurzfristige Finanzverbindlichkeiten 8,673,063 + 2,530,959. operating_cash_flow=14,630,424 (incl. 663,486 discontinued); free_cash_flow=less Investitionen Sachanlagen 1,082,150 and immaterielle 304,989. total_liabilities=langfristige 8,299,425 + kurzfristige Rueckstellungen und Verbindlichkeiten 36,534,275. interest_expense=Zinsaufwendungen 1,232,754. EPS not reported separately in the extracted statement and omitted.

CLIQ Digital AG Geschaeftsbericht 2025, Konzernabschluss (pp.25-31), EUR (statements in TEUR). revenue=Umsatzerloese 131,916 TEUR (2024: 243,017). operating_income=EBIT -13,676. ebitda=issuer-reported EBITDA -6,394 from the Gewinn- und Verlustrechnung (EBIT -13,676 + Abschreibungen 7,282). net_income=Konzernergebnis -12,448. total_debt=sonstige Finanzverbindlichkeiten langfristig 952 + kurzfristig 941 (no bank debt). operating_cash_flow=Netto Zahlungsmittelfluss aus betrieblicher Taetigkeit 22,642; free_cash_flow=22,642 less Investitionen in Sachanlagen 108 and immaterielle Vermoegenswerte 938. total_liabilities=Summe Schulden 13,170. eps=unverwaessert -2.13. interest_expense not separately reported (Finanzergebnis -510 net) so omitted.

Planoptik AG Geschaeftsbericht 2025, IFRS consolidated statements (Konzernbilanz p.44-45, Gesamtergebnisrechnung p.46-47, Kapitalflussrechnung p.76-77), EUR thousands. revenue=Umsatzerloese 11,274 (2024: 11,858). operating_income=Betriebsergebnis (EBIT) 129. ebitda=EBIT 129 + Abschreibungen 1,474 (BIAP-derived; income-statement D&A line incl. right-of-use assets). net_income=Konzernjahresergebnis -59. total_debt=non-current financial liabilities 951 + current financial liabilities 648 + non-current lease liabilities 2,139 + current lease liabilities 586. operating_cash_flow=269; free_cash_flow=269 less payments for fixed-asset investment 1,450. total_liabilities=non-current 3,098 + current 2,750. interest_expense=Finanzierungsaufwendungen 195. eps=unverwaessertes Ergebnis je Aktie -0.01. Source PDF downloaded from the issuer investor-relations site.

EnviTec Biogas AG Geschaeftsbericht 2025, group financial statements under German GAAP (HGB, not IFRS; no IFRS 16 lease liabilities, goodwill amortised) pp.46-51, EUR. revenue=Umsatzerloese 312,639,706 (2024: 337,699k). operating_income=Betriebsergebnis 28,650,506 (before equity-method result and financial items). ebitda=Betriebsergebnis 28,650,506 + Abschreibungen 29,014,975 (BIAP-derived; the single D&A line, equal to the cash-flow add-back). net_income=Konzernjahresueberschuss 16,655,624 incl. non-controlling interests. total_equity=190,946,770 incl. non-controlling interests 5,471,710. total_liabilities=total assets less equity (275,588,504; includes provisions 40,001,309, liabilities 227,244,427, deferred income 3,762,865 and negative consolidation difference 4,579,904). total_debt=liabilities to credit institutions 165,301,628. operating_cash_flow=Netto Cashflow 17,788,647; free_cash_flow=17,788,647 less payments for intangible (729,096) and tangible (30,712,864) assets. interest_expense=Zinsen und aehnliche Aufwendungen 5,521,744. current assets/liabilities and EPS omitted: HGB balance sheet has no current/non-current liability split and no EPS is reported. cash=Kassenbestand/Guthaben bei Kreditinstituten 25,686,532 (balance sheet, differs from the cash-flow fund 8,252,808).

HMS Bergbau AG Annual Report 2025 (first IFRS year; PDF pages 44 income statement, 45 balance sheet, 47 cash flow, 70 D&A note, 78-79 notes 27-31). EUR thousand x1000. ebitda = operating result 59,514 + depreciation 547 (issuer reports EBITDA EUR 60.1m); IFRS transition/consolidation effects (other operating income 45,471 incl. 39,523 consolidation result) inflate 2025 earnings. net_income = face-line 54,792 (the equity statement shows 52,249 after minority interests -2,543; unreconciled in the source). total_debt = convertible bonds 78,387 + loans/trade finance 13,012 + lease liabilities 824 + 500; current_liabilities = balance-sheet 'Short-term debt' 124,769 incl. trade payables. total_liabilities = long-term 100,226 + short-term 124,769.

Formycon AG Annual Report 2025 (PDF pages 149 financial position, 150 comprehensive income, 152 cash flows, 171 fixed-asset roll-forward, 199 notes 22-23). EUR thousand x1000. operating_income = EBIT -30,500 (before equity-method result and before the 59,597 goodwill/intangible impairment, which is shown below EBIT). ebitda = EBIT -30,500 + clean D&A 26,890 (note roll-forward total; cash-flow line 86,487 = 26,890 D&A + 59,597 impairment); issuer reports EBITDA -3.6m. total_debt = Nordic bond 70,051 (other non-current liabilities 202,551 less contingent purchase price 132,251 less share-based 249; derived) + lease obligations 8,082 + 1,478; contingent purchase-price obligations (132,251 + 12,083) excluded.

SINGULUS TECHNOLOGIES AG Annual Report 2025 (PDF pages 92-93 balance sheet, 94 income statement, 98 cash flow, 124-125 fixed-asset roll-forwards, management report p.45 KPI table). Schloss Wachenheim AG Geschaeftsbericht 2024/25, fiscal year 1 Jul 2024 - 30 Jun 2025 (PDF pages 110 balance sheet, 111 income statement, 113 cash flow, summary KPI p.9). EUR thousand x1000. This is the latest audited report; the FY2025/26 report (to 30 Jun 2026) was not published at the official host at review time, so exchange key data (revenue 448.9m, EBIT 27.6m) remain unaudited preliminary. ebitda = EBIT 27,153 + D&A and impairment 18,403 (issuer reports EBITDA 45.6m; impairment not separately disclosed, so impairment-inclusive by the issuer's definition). total_equity includes non-controlling interests 58,453. total_debt = Finanzverbindlichkeiten 48,033 + 50,013 as reported (IFRS 16 lease content not separated).

Viromed Medical AG Geschaeftsbericht 2025, voluntary consolidated statements under HGB (not IFRS; PDF pages 30-32 balance sheet, 33-34 income statement). EUR, rounded to whole euro. operating_income = revenue + other operating income - materials - personnel - D&A - other operating expenses (derived before interest/tax/other taxes): -866,768. ebitda = operating_income + D&A on fixed assets 524,424 (HGB, includes goodwill amortisation). Positive net income 604,514 is driven by other operating income 2.27m and deferred tax income 1.30m. total_liabilities = provisions 402,888 + liabilities 3,037,256. total_debt = bank 8,655 + shareholder liabilities 284,450 (other liabilities 1,546,861 not itemised as debt). No cash-flow statement extracted. ISIN DE000A40ZVN7 as in the listing; some issuer releases show DE000A3MQR65.

FINEXITY AG Annual Report 2025, audited HGB single-entity statements (MSW GmbH, unqualified; PDF pages 27-28 balance sheet, 29 income statement, 30 fixed-asset schedule). Group figures in the report are pro-forma and unaudited and are NOT used. EUR, whole euro. operating_income = output 1,734,700 + other income 4,444 - materials 911,386 - personnel 602,715 - D&A 18,766 - other operating expenses 1,418,563 = -1,212,285 (reconciles to net loss -1,198,183 via financial result +117,547 and taxes -103,444). ebitda = operating_income + D&A 18,766. Debt not itemised (other liabilities 1,243,272 incl. 1,005,141 over one year) so total_debt left empty.
